**Actuarial Life & Health Auto News Dashboard**（`ChiayuuW/actuarial-news-dashboard`）**是一个**只做**三段**的**精算资讯看板****——**逐字自述为**「**This is a simplified dashboard with only three sections**」**，**三段逐字为 **New**（**近七日**自动**收集**的**寿险／健康险**精算**消息）**、**Job**（**精算**就业市场**观察）**与 **Source**（**精选**核心**信源）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**先探空四个注册处面，再清待评清单**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-11 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每条卡片**逐字**带六项**，**其中**「**为什么重要**」**是**必填****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**「**Each card includes source, category, priority, summary, why it matters, and read-more link.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最值得**别的**信息**项目**学**的**：**⭐ 即**「**为什么**这条**值得**看**」**若**不**写成**字段**，**读者**就**只能**从**标题**猜**——**⭐ 而**在**信息**过载**的**行业里**，**「**摘要＋**为什么重要**」**这**两项**的**写作**成本**，**通常**就是**一个**资讯**产品**与**一个**链接**列表**的**分野**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**任何**「**每日**情报**」**类**小工具**，**都**建议**把**这六项**定成**固定**字段**。

**⭐⭐ ② 招聘段**跟**技能**，**而**不**只**跟**岗位****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字写**：**Job** 段**为**「**Actuarial job-market watch**」**，**逐字含**「**life, health, actuarial data analyst, and pricing/reserving search links**」**，**并逐字**「**Tracks common skills to watch in job descriptions.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一条**对**在读学生**最**实用**：**⭐ 即**「**岗位**名称**」**变化**慢**，**而**「**职位描述里**反复**出现的**技能**」**变化**快**——**⭐ 把**前者**当**索引**、**把**后者**当**信号**，**是**一种**可**复现**的**求职**信息**处理**方式**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 三种**运行**方式**逐字**对应**三种**使用者****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字给出**三条**路径**：**① **本地**（**逐字**：**Install Python 3. Unzip this package. Double-click `run_windows.bat`.**；**该批处理**会**安装**依赖、**运行**爬虫、**生成 **`data.json`、**并在 **`http://localhost:8000`** 起**本地**服务器）**；**② **手动**（**逐字**：**`pip install -r requirements.txt`**、**`python crawler.py`**、**`python -m http.server 8000`**）**；**③ **上线**（**逐字**：**Create a GitHub repository. Upload these files. Enable GitHub Pages.**，**并**逐字**说明**「**The GitHub Action will run daily and update `data.json`.**」**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**三种**交付**形态**」**本身**就是**一种**设计**取舍**的**示范**——**⭐ 同**一份**工具**，**对**不**写代码**的**同学**、**对**开发者**、**对**想**长期**自动**运行**的人**，**门槛**不同**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 定位**明确**：**求职**辅助**，**而**不**是**行业**数据库****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字把 **Source** 段**定位为**「**Curated core sources for a life/health actuarial career transition.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一句**值得**单独**记**：**⭐ 即**它**明确**了**服务**对象**（**寿险／健康险**方向**转职）**，**于是**它**的**取舍**（**只**三段、**只**看**近七日）**都**变得**合理**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**先**写**「**给谁**用**」**，**再**决定**「**做几段**」**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[actuarial-outpost]] 是**精算**社区**入口**、**[[asia-actuarial-job-market]] 覆盖**亚洲**精算**就业市场**、**[[acturhire-salary-guide]] 覆盖**薪酬**指南**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**自建**、**可**每日**自动**更新的**三段**资讯**看板**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **「**为什么重要**」**要**写成**字段**；**② **求职**信息**要**跟**技能**而**不**只**跟**岗位**；**③ **同一**工具**提供**三档**上手**门槛**；**④ **明确**服务**对象**再**决定**功能**取舍**；**⑤ **用**每日**定时**任务**把**「**更新**」**从**人**手上**拿走**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其爬虫、**没有生成** `data.json`、**没有打开**其看板**，**故**不主张**其**抓取**结果**、**不主张**其**新闻**与**岗位**链接**当前**有效**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其 **`crawler.py`** 与**前端**代码**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**卡片**中的**「**优先级**」**与**「**为什么重要**」**是**由**规则**、**模板**还是**模型**生成**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**信源**清单**的**具体**来源**与**授权**（**⭐ 逐字**只**说**精选**核心**信源**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**抓取**是否**遵守**各**网站的**条款**与 **robots** 规则**（**⭐ 本词条**只**记录**其**自述**的**自动**收集**）。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 该看板**是**信息**工具**，**其**内容**不**构成**职业**或**投资建议**。

e.body_en:
This is an actuarial information dashboard that does only three things, stating in writing that it is a simplified dashboard with three sections covering recently collected life and health actuarial news, a job market watch, and curated sources. **This entry belongs to the round theme of probing four registry surfaces, finding them empty, and then clearing the review backlog.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-11 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, every card carries six fields, and why it matters is one of them.** The description states that each card includes source, category, priority, summary, a why-it-matters note, and a read-more link. **If the reason an item is worth reading is not a field, the reader can only infer it from a headline, and in an industry with too much information the writing cost of a summary plus a why-it-matters line is usually what separates an information product from a list of links, so any daily-intelligence style tool is worth designing with those six fields fixed.**

**Second, the jobs section follows skills rather than only openings.** The description names it as an actuarial job-market watch with search links across life, health, actuarial data analysis, and pricing and reserving, and states that it tracks common skills to watch for in job descriptions. **Job titles change slowly while the skills named inside job descriptions change quickly, and treating the former as an index and the latter as a signal is a reproducible way to handle career information.**

**Third, three ways of running it map onto three kinds of user.** The description gives a local path in which installing Python, unzipping the package, and double-clicking a batch file installs dependencies, runs the crawler, generates the data file, and starts a local server; a manual path of three commands; and a hosted path in which uploading the files to a repository and enabling pages lets a daily automated job update the data file. **Offering one tool at three levels of entry is itself a demonstration of design trade-offs, because students who do not program, developers, and people who want long-running automation all have different thresholds.**

**Fourth, the positioning is explicit: a job-seeking aid rather than an industry database.** The sources section is described in writing as curated core sources for a career transition into life and health actuarial work. **Naming the intended user makes the trade-offs, only three sections and only a recent window, reasonable, and the lesson is to write down who the tool is for before deciding how many parts it has.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an actuarial community hub, an Asian actuarial job market, and a salary guide, **while this entry supplies the form of a self-hosted three-section information dashboard with a daily automated update. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: make the why-it-matters note a field; track skills rather than only titles in career information; offer one tool at three levels of entry; name the intended user before choosing features; and let a scheduled job take over updating.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the crawler was not run, no data file was generated, and the dashboard was not opened**, **so no claim is made about what it collects or about whether its news and job links currently work**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the crawler or the front end. **Third, whether the priority and why-it-matters fields are produced by rules, templates, or a model was not verified. Fourth, the origin and permissions of the source list were not verified**, the text only calling them curated core sources. **Fifth, the repository carries no licence file. Sixth, whether its crawling respects the terms and robots rules of the sites it visits was not verified**, this entry recording only the stated automatic collection. **Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that the dashboard is an information tool whose content is neither career nor investment advice.**
